purpose: Executable ledger for the `causal-intervention-counterfactual` route-support family; normalized schema envelope added in rev0293.
non_promotion_rule: Causal mechanisms, intervention protocols, and counterfactual robustness rows are denominators and caps. They do not promote a route; they only license or forbid mechanism, cause, mediator, intervention, ablation, natural-experiment, and counterfactual wording at the route ceiling already earned elsewhere.

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether boundary/code-subspace records structurally determine the declared bulk target inside one holographic dictionary
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: boundary algebra, entropy, and decoder relations treated as structural dependencies inside the selected code space, not as direct manipulation of the bulk ontology
mechanism_rows.causal_claim_grain: package-grain formal dependence under dictionary quotient
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: formal dictionary variations are not physical interventions on the candidate-native bulk ontology
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: duality presentations, dictionary choice, code-space prior, gauge/frame quotient, and code-subspace overfit controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: reconstruction remains stable under allowed code-space perturbations, overlap checks, and alternative dictionary presentations

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether learned inverse benchmarks identify a candidate-native reconstruction map rather than a surrogate simulator target
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: training distribution, simulator target, decoder architecture, and loss surface induce a generative mapping from records to reconstructed targets
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: simulator ablation is not physical intervention on the target theory and can leak target assumptions
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: train/test leakage, simulator-target mismatch, benchmark overfit, quotient ambiguity, and thin-data stress controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: inverse behavior survives out-of-distribution, no-inversion, policy-robustness, and simulator-ablation tests

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether thermodynamic or entropic structure causally explains gravitational dynamics rather than re-expressing known equations
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: entropy, horizon/causal patch, equation-of-state, and equilibrium/near-equilibrium assumptions generate effective field-equation recovery
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: macroscopic thermodynamic variation is not a candidate-native intervention on microscopic gravity degrees of freedom
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: equation-recovery circularity, missing microstructure, non-equilibrium failure, and observed-sector underrecovery controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: derivation remains stable under altered entropy functional, local equilibrium assumptions, and perturbative matter content

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether atlas/compactification records identify a unique physical vacuum mechanism rather than a chart or post-hoc selection
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: duality atlas, compactification data, moduli stabilization, and vacuum-selection assumptions connect high-dimensional formal structure to observed sectors
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: vacuum choice and duality-chart changes are formal or environmental selections, not controlled interventions on the universe
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: duality-equivalence, landscape measure, post-hoc vacuum, moduli/nuisance, and low-energy recovery controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: candidate reading survives duality chart changes, compactification perturbations, and low-energy sector crosswalk checks

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether an RG fixed-point mechanism controls continuum gravity rather than a truncation artifact
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: renormalization-group flow, regulator choice, truncation basis, and fixed-point stability generate a continuum-limit candidate corridor
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: regulator and truncation changes are formal perturbations, not direct interventions on physical UV degrees of freedom
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: truncation artifact, regulator dependence, finite projection, and low-energy matching controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: fixed-point and critical exponents remain stable under enlarged truncations and regulator variations

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether discrete causal-order dynamics generate continuum spacetime features rather than merely simulating selected observables
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: growth dynamics, order relation, sprinkling/measure assumptions, and continuum approximation connect causal-set histories to observable proxies
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: simulated growth or sprinkling variation is not a public intervention on actual spacetime microstructure
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: continuum approximation, nonunique dynamics, finite-size effects, and simulator-target leakage controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: continuum proxies and order-theoretic observables remain stable under dynamics, sprinkling, and finite-size variations

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether amplitude/positivity/bootstrap constraints identify a physical mediator or UV mechanism rather than consistency of an EFT class
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: analyticity, unitarity, locality, crossing, soft behavior, and positivity constraints restrict observable amplitudes and EFT coefficients
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: constraint variation is not a physical intervention on the UV completion or mediator ontology
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: many-completion degeneracy, EFT cutoff, positivity-domain, and amplitude-basis controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: constraints remain stable under basis, cutoff, loop/order, and dispersion-assumption variations

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether a controlled lab protocol supports a quantum gravitational mediator claim rather than a classical-hybrid, subsystem, or apparatus confound
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: mass preparation, path superposition, gravitational coupling, environmental isolation, and entanglement/phase readout generate a mediator-discriminator record
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: the apparatus can intervene on masses and paths but not directly on fundamental gravitational ontology
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: classical-hybrid mediator, subsystem independence, decoherence, environmental coupling, and apparatus calibration controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: mediator reading survives phase/entanglement, control-arm, shielding, noise-budget, and subsystem-independence stress tests

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether strong-field waveform catalogs support a gravity-mechanism claim or only constrain deviations within waveform/model classes
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: binary dynamics, waveform generation, detector response, calibration, and catalog inference connect astrophysical events to GR-deviation tests
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: astrophysical events are not manipulable experiments; source distribution and detector network act as natural observational variation
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: waveform prior, detector calibration, selection bias, source-population, and modified-GR degeneracy controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: constraint survives waveform families, calibration uncertainty, source-selection, and detector-network stress tests

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether reference-frame transformations preserve public records or merely rename frame-relative descriptions
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: frame choice, relational observable map, transport rule, and equivalence convention connect frame-relative descriptions to public record claims
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: changing reference frame is an operational/formal transformation rather than an intervention on the underlying event itself
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: gauge/frame convention, counterpart relation, observer-access, and public-record equivalence controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: record identity survives explicit frame transformations, counterpart rules, and relational observable assays

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether single-graviton/statistical trigger records support quantum gravitational state attribution rather than detector/source-model coincidence
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: source state, detector response, trigger correlation, noise model, and catalog/custody chain connect rare events to quantum-gravity interaction pressure
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: source and detector settings may be perturbed, but the graviton-state ontology remains indirectly inferred
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: source-state attribution, detector false positives, classical-wave mimicry, coincidence window, and calibration controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: trigger pattern survives source-state, detector threshold, noise, timing, and null-channel stress tests

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether late-time expansion data support a dark-energy mechanism rather than parameterization, prior, or survey-nuisance pressure
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: BAO, SNe, CMB-linked calibration, likelihood model, and dark-energy parameterization connect survey records to expansion-history constraints
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: cosmological history is not manipulable; mechanism claims rely on model counterfactuals and natural variation only
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: parameterization, prior bound, survey systematic, nuisance covariance, and model-class degeneracy controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: interpretation survives likelihood replay, prior-bound shifts, nuisance stress tests, and alternative dark-energy parameterizations

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether tensor/B-mode records support a primordial quantum-gravity mechanism rather than foreground, delensing, or many-model early-universe pressure
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: CMB polarization map, foreground model, delensing pipeline, tensor likelihood, and early-universe model class connect observed B-modes to primordial-tensor constraints
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: the early universe is not manipulable; mechanism claims require counterfactual model and foreground/delensing stress tests
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: foreground residual, lensing, reheating/model degeneracy, instrument/systematic, and many-mechanism controls
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: tensor inference survives foreground-cleaning, delensing, instrument, prior, and model-class stress tests

mechanism_rows.causal_question: whether metadata/provenance wrappers themselves supply causal or mechanistic evidence
mechanism_rows.proposed_structure: metadata and provenance organize custody, replay, and versioning; they do not produce a physical causal mechanism
mechanism_rows.manipulability_or_intervention_gap: package/version changes are archive interventions, not physical interventions on a theory candidate
mechanism_rows.confounding_or_common_cause_controls: metadata presence, repository identity, generated summaries, and provenance wrappers cannot be counted as causal evidence
mechanism_rows.invariance_or_mechanism_stability_test: custody stability may improve replay but cannot upgrade route causal status
